mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, conditions are clear at Badger Prairie County Park. We are currently under a new moon phase, and although the ISS will pass overhead tonight, we will not be able to see it due to the cloudy skies.
There are no new emails or city news articles to report for the Verona area at this time.
We have several trivia options today, including events at Hop Haus Brewing Co, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, live music is coming to Paddy Mac's tomorrow.
There were no incidents to report in the Verona Police Department weekly update.
Today's featured flavor is Chocolate Heath Crunch. The store will open today at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 10:00 PM.
